def main():
    n=2
    names = ["Eric", "Arnold"]
    music = ["rock", "pop"]
    styles = ["colonial", "victorian"]
    lunches = ["grilled cheese", "pizza"]
    sports = ["basketball", "soccer"]
    children = ["Bella", "Fred"]

    name = [Int(f"name_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    music_v = [Int(f"music_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    style = [Int(f"style_{i}") for i in range(n)]

from z3 import *

H = 6
categories = {
    "name": ["Bob", "Carol", "Eric", "Alice", "Peter", "Arnold"],
    "vacation": ["camping", "cruise", "mountain", "cultural", "city", "beach"],
    "pet": ["fish", "hamster", "bird", "rabbit", "dog", "cat"],
    "nationality": ["brit", "swede", "german", "norwegian", "dane", "chinese"],
    "book": ["biography", "romance", "mystery", "fantasy", "science fiction", "historical fiction"],
    "car": ["tesla model 3", "bmw 3 series", "honda civic", "chevrolet silverado", "toyota camry", "ford f150"],
}

x = {}
for cat, vals in categories.items():
    for h in range(H):
        for vi in range(len(vals)):
            x[(cat, h, vi)] = Bool(f"{cat}_{h}_{vi}")

s = Solver()

def exactly_one(lits):
    s.add(Or(lits))
    for i in range(len(lits)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(lits)):
            s.add(Not(And(lits[i], lits[j])))

for cat, vals in categories.items():
    for h in range(H):
        exactly_one([x[(cat, h, vi)] for vi in range(len(vals))])
    for vi in range(len(vals)):
        exactly_one([x[(cat, h, vi)] for h in range(H)])

idx = {cat: {v: i for i, v in enumerate(vals)} for cat, vals in categories.items()}

def at(cat, h, val):
    return x[(cat, h, idx[cat][val])]

def same_house(c1, v1, c2, v2):
    for h in range(H):
        s.add(at(c1, h, v1) == at(c2, h, v2))

def directly_left(c1, v1, c2, v2):
    s.add(Or([at(c1, h, v1) & at(c2, h + 1, v2) for h in range(H - 1)]))

def one_house_between(c1, v1, c2, v2, ordered=False):
    clauses = []
    for h in range(H - 2):
        clauses.append(at(c1, h, v1) & at(c2, h + 2, v2))
        if not ordered:
            clauses.append(at(c2, h, v1) & at(c1, h + 2, v2))
    s.add(Or(clauses))

def right_of(c_left, v_left, c_right, v_right):
    clauses = []
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(i + 1, H):
            clauses.append(at(c_left, i, v_left) & at(c_right, j, v_right))
    s.add(Or(clauses))

def left_of(c_left, v_left, c_right, v_right):
    clauses = []
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(i + 1, H):
            clauses.append(at(c_left, i, v_left) & at(c_right, j, v_right))
    s.add(Or(clauses))

```python
from z3 import *

def main():
    H = 5
    categories = {
        'name': ['Bob', 'Arnold', 'Alice', 'Peter', 'Eric'],
        'hobby': ['cooking', 'gardening', 'painting', 'photography', 'knitting'],
        'sport': ['swimming', 'tennis', 'soccer', 'baseball', 'basketball'],
        'style': ['ranch', 'craftsman', 'victorian', 'modern', 'colonial'],
        'child': ['Timothy', 'Samantha', 'Bella', 'Meredith', 'Fred'],
        'height': ['average', 'very tall', 'very short', 'short', 'tall'],
    }
    s = Solver()
    V = {}
    for cat, vals in categories.items():
        V[cat] = [[Bool(f'{cat}_{i}_{j}') for j in range(len(vals))] for i in range(H)]
        for i in range(H):
            s.add(Sum([V[cat][i][j] for j in range(len(vals))]) == 1)
        for j in range(len(vals)):
            s.add(Sum([V[cat][i][j] for i in range(H)]) == 1)

    def idx(cat, val):
        return categories[cat].index(val)

    def same(cat1, val1, cat2, val2):
        a = idx(cat1, val1); b = idx(cat2, val2)
        for i in range(H):
            s.add(V[cat1][i][a] == V[cat2][i][b])

    def adjacent(cat1, val1, cat2, val2):
        a = idx(cat1, val1); b = idx(cat2, val2)
        s.add(Or([
            (V[cat1][i][a] & V[cat2][i+1][b]) |
            (V[cat1][i+1][a] & V[cat2][i][b])
            for i in range(H-1)
        ]))

    def left_of(cat1, val1, cat2, val2, direct=False):
        a = idx(cat1, val1); b = idx(cat2, val2)
        if direct:
            s.add(Or([V[cat1][i][a] & V[cat2][i+1][b] for i in range(H-1)]))
        else:
            s.add(Or([V[cat1][i][a] & V[cat2][j][b] for i in range(H) for j in range(i+1, H)]))

    # 1 average height child Meredith
    same('height', 'average', 'child', 'Meredith')
    # 2 tall second
    s.add(V['height'][1][idx('height','tall')])
    # 3 Peter directly left of Victorian
    left_of('name', 'Peter', 'style', 'Victorian', direct=True)
    # 4 Alice tall
    same('name', 'Alice', 'height', 'tall')
    # 5 baseball very tall
    same('sport', 'baseball', 'height', 'very tall')
    # 6 Meredith and Timothy next to each other
    adjacent('child', 'Meredith', 'child', 'Timothy')
    # 7 Bob painting
    same('name', 'Bob', 'hobby', 'painting')
    # 8 gardening second
    s.add(V['hobby'][1][idx('hobby','gardening')])
    # 9 very short right of Eric
    left_of('name', 'Eric', 'height', 'very short')
    # 10 tennis Samantha
    same('sport', 'tennis', 'child', 'Samantha')
    # 11 soccer not first
    s.add(Not(V['sport'][0][idx('sport','soccer')]))
    # 12 Samantha modern
    same('child', 'Samantha', 'style', 'modern')
    # 13 Craftsman average
    same('style', 'craftsman', 'height', 'average')
    # 14 Fred Victorian
    same('child', 'Fred', 'style', 'Victorian')
    # 15 short basketball
    same('height', 'short', 'sport', 'basketball')
    # 16 Peter very tall
    same('name', 'Peter', 'height', 'very tall')
    # 17 ranch left of cooking
    left_of('style', 'ranch', 'hobby', 'cooking')
    # 18 knitting gardening adjacent
    adjacent('hobby', 'knitting', 'hobby', 'gardening')
    # 19 modern cooking
    same('style', 'modern', 'hobby', 'cooking')
    # 20 Victorian fifth
    s.add(V['style'][4][idx('style','Victorian')])

    if s.check() != sat:
        return
    m = s.model()
    def value(cat, i):
        for j, val in enumerate(categories[cat]):
            if m.eval(V[cat][i][j], model_completion=True).as_bool():
                return val
        return '?'
    order = ['name','hobby','sport','style','child','height']
    for i in range(H):
        print(f"House {i+1}: " + ", ".join(value(cat, i) for cat in order))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

from z3 import *

def main():
    N = 6
    name_values = ["Bob", "Arnold", "Peter", "Alice", "Eric", "Carol"]
    nat_values = ["swede", "dane", "german", "norwegian", "chinese", "brit"]
    color_values = ["red", "green", "purple", "blue", "white", "yellow"]

    name = [Int(f"name_{i}") for i in range(N)]
    nat = [Int(f"nat_{i}") for i in range(N)]
    color = [Int(f"color_{i}") for i in range(N)]

    s = Solver()
    for i in range(N):
        s.add(name[i] >= 0, name[i] < len(name_values))
        s.add(nat[i] >= 0, nat[i] < len(nat_values))
        s.add(color[i] >= 0, color[i] < len(color_values))
    s.add(Distinct(name))
    s.add(Distinct(nat))
    s.add(Distinct(color))

    name_id = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(name_values)}
    nat_id = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(nat_values)}
    color_id = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(color_values)}

    def same_house(a, av, b, bv):
        return Or([And(a[i] == av, b[i] == bv) for i in range(N)])

    s.add(Or([And(name[i] == name_id["Alice"], name[i + 1] == name_id["Bob"]) for i in range(N - 1)]))
    s.add(same_house(color, color_id["green"], nat, nat_id["brit"]))
    s.add(Or([And(name[i] == name_id["Alice"], nat[j] == nat_id["german"], i < j) for i in range(N) for j in range(N)]))
    s.add(same_house(color, color_id["blue"], nat, nat_id["dane"]))
    s.add(same_house(name, name_id["Eric"], color, color_id["purple"]))
    s.add(name[1] == name_id["Carol"])
    s.add(nat[1] != nat_id["swede"])
    s.add(nat[0] != nat_id["swede"])
    s.add(Or([And(color[i] == color_id["white"], nat[i + 1] == nat_id["norwegian"]) for i in range(N - 1)]))
    s.add(Or([
        And(name[i] == name_id["Alice"], color[j] == color_id["yellow"], j - i == 3)
        for i in range(N) for j in range(N)
    ] + [
        And(name[i] == name_id["Alice"], color[j] == color_id["yellow"], i - j == 3)
        for i in range(N) for j in range(N)
    ]))
    s.add(nat[4] == nat_id["dane"])
    s.add(same_house(color, color_id["blue"], name, name_id["Peter"]))

    if s.check() == sat:
        m = s.model()
        for i in range(N):
            print(f"House {i + 1}: {name_values[m[name[i]].as_long()]}, {nat_values[m[nat[i]].as_long()]}, {color_values[m[color[i]].as_long()]}")
    else:
        print("No solution")

```python
from z3 import *

def main():
    houses = 3
    categories = {
        "name": ["Arnold", "Eric", "Peter"],
        "genre": ["mystery", "romance", "science fiction"],
        "phone": ["google pixel 6", "iphone 13", "samsung galaxy s21"],
        "height": ["short", "very short", "average"],
        "flower": ["daffodils", "lilies", "carnations"],
        "lunch": ["pizza", "grilled cheese", "spaghetti"],
    }

    var = {}
    for cat, values in categories.items():
        var[cat] = []
        for h in range(houses):
            row = []
            for value in values:
                row.append(Bool(f"{cat}_{h}_{value.replace(' ', '_')}"))
            var[cat].append(row)

    solver = Solver()

    for cat, values in categories.items():
        for h in range(houses):
            solver.add(Or(*[var[cat][h][i] for i in range(len(values))]))
            for i in range(len(values)):
                for j in range(i + 1, len(values)):
                    solver.add(Not(And(var[cat][h][i], var[cat][h][j])))
        for i in range(len(values)):
            solver.add(Or(*[var[cat][h][i] for h in range(houses)]))
            for h1 in range(houses):
                for h2 in range(h1 + 1, houses):
                    solver.add(Not(And(var[cat][h1][i], var[cat][h2][i])))

    def index(cat, value):
        return categories[cat].index(value)

    def same(cat1, value1, cat2, value2):
        i1 = index(cat1, value1)
        i2 = index(cat2, value2)
        for h in range(houses):
            solver.add(var[cat1][h][i1] == var[cat2][h][i2])

    same("phone", "samsung galaxy s21", "height", "short")

    carnation_i = index("flower", "carnations")
    iphone_i = index("phone", "iphone 13")
    solver.add(
        Or(
            And(var["flower"][0][carnation_i], var["phone"][1][iphone_i]),
            And(var["flower"][1][carnation_i], var["phone"][2][iphone_i]),
        )
    )

    same("name", "Peter", "genre", "romance")
    solver.add(Not(var["lunch"][0][index("lunch", "grilled cheese")]))
    same("name", "Arnold", "genre", "science fiction")
    same("flower", "daffodils", "height", "very short")
    same("phone", "samsung galaxy s21", "genre", "science fiction")
    same("genre", "science fiction", "lunch", "pizza")
    solver.add(var["name"][2][index("name", "Arnold")])
    same("name", "Peter", "height", "very short")

    result = solver.check()
    if result != sat:
        return
    model = solver.model()

    def get_value(cat, h):
        for i, value in enumerate(categories[cat]):
            if is_true(model.eval(var[cat][h][i])):
                return value
        return "unknown"

    order = ["name", "genre", "phone", "height", "flower", "lunch"]
    for h in range(houses):
        attrs = [get_value(cat, h) for cat in order]
        print(f"House {h + 1}: " + ", ".join(attrs))

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

from z3 import *

    houses = 3

    vars = {}
    for cat, vals in values.items():
       vars[cat] = [Int(f"{cat}_house_{i+1}") for i in range(houses)]
       for i in range(houses):
          s.add(Or(*[vars[cat][i] == j for j in range(len(vals))]))
       s.add(Distinct(*vars[cat]))
    def idx(cat, val): return values[cat].index(val)
    # 1
    for h in range(houses):
       s.add(Implies(vars['education'][h] == idx('education','associate'), vars['name'][h] == idx('name','Eric')))
       s.add(Implies(vars['name'][h] == idx('name','Eric'), vars['education'][h] == idx('education','associate')))
    # 2
    s.add(vars['vacation'][1] == idx('vacation','mountain'))
    # 3
    s.add(Or(*[And(vars['name'][i] == idx('name','Arnold'), vars['animal'][j] == idx('animal','cat')) for i in range(houses) for j in range(houses) if i > j]))
    # 4
    for h in range(houses):
       s.add(Implies(vars['vacation'][h] == idx('vacation','mountain'), vars['animal'][h] == idx('animal','bird')))
       s.add(Implies(vars['animal'][h] == idx('animal','bird'), vars['vacation'][h] == idx('vacation','mountain')))
    # 5
    s.add(Or(*[And(vars['education'][i] == idx('education','high school'), vars['vacation'][j] == idx('vacation','beach')) for i in range(houses) for j in range(houses) if i > j]))
    # 6
    s.add(vars['education'][2] == idx('education','high school'))
    # 7
    s.add(vars['education'][0] != idx('education','associate'))
    if s.check() == sat:
       m = s.model()
       for h in range(houses):
          attrs = [values[cat][int(m.evaluate(vars[cat][h]))] for cat in ['name','vacation','education','animal']]
          print(f"House {h+1}: " + ", ".join(attrs))
    else:

if __name__ == "__main__": main()

```python
def main():
    houses = [1,2,3,4,5]

    add_category(education)
    add_category(animals)

            value_at(h, education),
            value_at(h, animals)
        ))

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

```python
from z3 import *

def main():
    solver = Solver()

    names = {
        "Arnold": IntVar("name_arnold"),
        "Peter": IntVar("name_peter"),
        "Eric": IntVar("name_eric"),
        "Alice": IntVar("name_alice"),
        "Bob": IntVar("name_bob"),
    }
    hobbies = {
        "painting": IntVar("hobby_painting"),
        "cooking": IntVar("hobby_cooking"),
        "knitting": IntVar("hobby_knitting"),
        "gardening": IntVar("hobby_gardening"),
        "photography": IntVar("hobby_photography"),
    }
    heights = {
        "very tall": IntVar("height_very_tall"),
        "tall": IntVar("height_tall"),
        "very short": IntVar("height_very_short"),
        "average": IntVar("height_average"),
        "short": IntVar("height_short"),
    }
    lunches = {
        "stew": IntVar("lunch_stew"),
        "grilled cheese": IntVar("lunch_grilled_cheese"),
        "stir fry": IntVar("lunch_stir_fry"),
        "spaghetti": IntVar("lunch_spaghetti"),
        "pizza": IntVar("lunch_pizza"),
    }

    all_vars = list(names.values()) + list(hobbies.values()) + list(heights.values()) + list(lunches.values())
    for v in all_vars:
        solver.add(v >= 1, v <= 5)

    solver.add(AllDifferent(list(names.values())))
    solver.add(AllDifferent(list(hobbies.values())))
    solver.add(AllDifferent(list(heights.values())))
    solver.add(AllDifferent(list(lunches.values())))

    solver.add(names["Bob"] == hobbies["photography"])
    solver.add(lunches["grilled cheese"] == heights["tall"])
    solver.add(names["Peter"] != 2)
    solver.add(heights["tall"] + 1 == lunches["stir fry"])
    solver.add(hobbies["cooking"] == heights["average"])
    solver.add(names["Alice"] + 1 == lunches["pizza"])
    solver.add(lunches["spaghetti"] != 2)
    solver.add(names["Eric"] != 5)
    solver.add(heights["short"] == names["Peter"])
    solver.add(Abs(heights["average"] - hobbies["gardening"]) == 1)
    solver.add(hobbies["painting"] + 1 == lunches["grilled cheese"])
    solver.add(heights["very short"] == 5)
    solver.add(heights["tall"] == 3)
    solver.add(names["Alice"] > hobbies["photography"])

    if solver.check() != sat:
        print("No solution")
        return

    m = solver.model()
    def house_map(attrs):
        mp = {}
        for attr, var in attrs.items():
            val = m.evaluate(var, model_completion=True).as_long()
            mp[val] = attr
        return mp

    name_by_house = house_map(names)
    hobby_by_house = house_map(hobbies)
    height_by_house = house_map(heights)
    lunch_by_house = house_map(lunches)

    for h in range(1, 6):
        print(f"House {h}: {name_by_house[h]}, {hobby_by_house[h]}, {height_by_house[h]}, {lunch_by_house[h]}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```
        "car": ["ford f150", "tesla model 3", "toyota camry"],
        "month": ["april", "jan", "sept"],
        "music": ["rock", "classical", "pop"],
    }

    solver = Solver()
    variables = {}

    def add_exactly_one(booleans):
        solver.add(Or(*booleans))
        for i in range(len(booleans)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(booleans)):
                solver.add(Not(And(booleans[i], booleans[j])))

    for cat, vals in categories.items():
        n = len(vals)
        vs = [[Bool(f"{cat}_h{h}_v{i}") for i in range(n)] for h in houses]
        variables[cat] = vs
        for h in houses:
            add_exactly_one(vs[h])
        for i in range(n):
            add_exactly_one([vs[h][i] for h in houses])

    def value_index(cat, val):
        return categories[cat].index(val)

    def has(cat, val, h):
        return variables[cat][h][value_index(cat, val)]

    solver.add(
        Or(
            And(has("book", "romance", 0), has("car", "ford f150", 1)),
            And(has("book", "romance", 1), has("car", "ford f150", 2)),
        )
    )

    for h in houses:
        solver.add(Implies(has("month", "sept", h), has("car", "toyota camry", h)))
        solver.add(Implies(has("car", "toyota camry", h), has("month", "sept", h)))

        solver.add(Implies(has("pet", "cat", h), has("name", "Arnold", h)))

        solver.add(Implies(has("book", "science fiction", h), has("car", "tesla model 3", h)))

        solver.add(Implies(has("car", "ford f150", h), has("music", "pop", h)))
        solver.add(Implies(has("music", "pop", h), has("car", "ford f150", h)))
```

from z3 import *

def main():
    s = Solver()

    names = ["Peter", "Arnold", "Bob", "Alice", "Eric", "Carol"]
    mothers = ["Holly", "Aniya", "Kailyn", "Janelle", "Penny", "Sarah"]
    lunches = ["stir fry", "stew", "spaghetti", "soup", "pizza", "grilled cheese"]
    animals = ["dog", "horse", "cat", "fish", "rabbit", "bird"]
    smoothies = ["watermelon", "desert", "lime", "cherry", "blueberry", "dragonfruit"]
    styles = ["mediterranean", "craftsman", "victorian", "colonial", "modern", "ranch"]

    def make_vars(values, prefix):
        return {v: Int(f"{prefix}_{v.replace(' ', '_')}") for v in values}

    name_vars = make_vars(names, "name")
    mother_vars = make_vars(mothers, "mother")
    lunch_vars = make_vars(lunches, "lunch")
    animal_vars = make_vars(animals, "animal")
    smoothie_vars = make_vars(smoothies, "smoothie")
    style_vars = make_vars(styles, "style")

    for category in (name_vars, mother_vars, lunch_vars, animal_vars, smoothie_vars, style_vars):
        s.add(Distinct(list(category.values())))
        for var in category.values():
            s.add(var >= 1, var <= 6)

    s.add(mother_vars["Penny"] == style_vars["victorian"])
    s.add(style_vars["modern"] == mother_vars["Kailyn"])
    s.add(style_vars["modern"] > style_vars["victorian"])
    s.add(smoothie_vars["blueberry"] != 6)
    s.add(mother_vars["Sarah"] == smoothie_vars["blueberry"])
    s.add(smoothie_vars["cherry"] != 3)
    s.add(smoothie_vars["cherry"] == name_vars["Eric"])
    s.add(mother_vars["Janelle"] != 3)
    s.add(lunch_vars["spaghetti"] == 3)
    s.add(animal_vars["fish"] == mother_vars["Holly"])
    s.add(animal_vars["horse"] == 1)
    s.add(style_vars["mediterranean"] == lunch_vars["stew"])
    s.add(animal_vars["bird"] == 3)
    s.add(style_vars["colonial"] == smoothie_vars["blueberry"])
    s.add(name_vars["Carol"] == animal_vars["horse"])
    s.add(Abs(smoothie_vars["desert"] - name_vars["Peter"]) == 3)
    s.add(lunch_vars["grilled cheese"] == smoothie_vars["dragonfruit"])
    s.add(lunch_vars["pizza"] > smoothie_vars["dragonfruit"])
    s.add(mother_vars["Janelle"] < name_vars["Arnold"])
    s.add(name_vars["Carol"] + 1 == mother_vars["Aniya"])
    s.add(style_vars["ranch"] == mother_vars["Aniya"])
    s.add(name_vars["Arnold"] > style_vars["craftsman"])
    s.add(animal_vars["cat"] == name_vars["Bob"])
    s.add(Abs(smoothie_vars["watermelon"] - lunch_vars["pizza"]) == 2)
    s.add(Abs(animal_vars["cat"] - lunch_vars["stir fry"]) == 3)
    s.add(name_vars["Arnold"] == animal_vars["rabbit"])
    s.add(name_vars["Peter"] == mother_vars["Janelle"])

    if s.check() != sat:
        return

    m = s.model()

    def pos(var):
        return m.eval(var, model_completion=True).as_long()

    def value_at(category, house):
        for value, var in category.items():
            if pos(var) == house:
                return value
        return "unknown"

    for house in range(1, 7):
        print(
            f"House {house}: "
            f"{value_at(name_vars, house)}, "
            f"{value_at(mother_vars, house)}, "
            f"{value_at(lunch_vars, house)}, "
            f"{value_at(animal_vars, house)}, "
            f"{value_at(smoothie_vars, house)}, "
            f"{value_at(style_vars, house)}"
        )

if __name__ == "__main__":

from z3 import *

def main():
    s = Solver()

    names = ["Peter", "Arnold", "Bob", "Alice", "Eric", "Carol"]
    mothers = ["Holly", "Aniya", "Kailyn", "Janelle", "Penny", "Sarah"]
    lunches = ["stir fry", "stew", "spaghetti", "soup", "pizza", "grilled cheese"]
    animals = ["dog", "horse", "cat", "fish", "rabbit", "bird"]
    smoothies = ["watermelon", "desert", "lime", "cherry", "blueberry", "dragonfruit"]
    styles = ["mediterranean", "craftsman", "victorian", "colonial", "modern", "ranch"]

    def make_vars(values, prefix):
        return {v: Int(f"{prefix}_{v.replace(' ', '_')}") for v in values}

    name_vars = make_vars(names, "name")
    mother_vars = make_vars(mothers, "mother")
    lunch_vars = make_vars(lunches, "lunch")
    animal_vars = make_vars(animals, "animal")
    smoothie_vars = make_vars(smoothies, "smoothie")
    style_vars = make_vars(styles, "style")

    for category in (name_vars, mother_vars, lunch_vars, animal_vars, smoothie_vars, style_vars):
        s.add(Distinct(list(category.values())))
        for var in category.values():
            s.add(var >= 1, var <= 6)

    def distance(a, b, d):
        s.add(Or(a - b == d, b - a == d))

    s.add(mother_vars["Penny"] == style_vars["victorian"])
    s.add(style_vars["modern"] == mother_vars["Kailyn"])
    s.add(style_vars["modern"] > style_vars["victorian"])
    s.add(smoothie_vars["blueberry"] != 6)
    s.add(mother_vars["Sarah"] == smoothie_vars["blueberry"])
    s.add(smoothie_vars["cherry"] != 3)
    s.add(smoothie_vars["cherry"] == name_vars["Eric"])
    s.add(mother_vars["Janelle"] != 3)
    s.add(lunch_vars["spaghetti"] == 3)
    s.add(animal_vars["fish"] == mother_vars["Holly"])
    s.add(animal_vars["horse"] == 1)
    s.add(style_vars["mediterranean"] == lunch_vars["stew"])
    s.add(animal_vars["bird"] == 3)
    s.add(style_vars["colonial"] == smoothie_vars["blueberry"])
    s.add(name_vars["Carol"] == animal_vars["horse"])
    distance(smoothie_vars["desert"], name_vars["Peter"], 3)
    s.add(lunch_vars["grilled cheese"] == smoothie_vars["dragonfruit"])
    s.add(lunch_vars["pizza"] > smoothie_vars["dragonfruit"])
    s.add(mother_vars["Janelle"] < name_vars["Arnold"])
    s.add(name_vars["Carol"] + 1 == mother_vars["Aniya"])
    s.add(style_vars["ranch"] == mother_vars["Aniya"])
    s.add(name_vars["Arnold"] > style_vars["craftsman"])
    s.add(animal_vars["cat"] == name_vars["Bob"])
    distance(smoothie_vars["watermelon"], lunch_vars["pizza"], 2)
    distance(animal_vars["cat"], lunch_vars["stir fry"], 3)
    s.add(name_vars["Arnold"] == animal_vars["rabbit"])
    s.add(name_vars["Peter"] == mother_vars["Janelle"])

    if s.check() != sat:
        return

    m = s.model()

    def pos(var):
        return m.eval(var, model_completion=True).as_long()

    def value_at(category, house):
        for value, var in category.items():
            if pos(var) == house:
                return value
        return "unknown"

    for house in range(1, 7):
        print(
            f"House {house}: "
            f"{value_at(name_vars, house)}, "
            f"{value_at(mother_vars, house)}, "
            f"{value_at(lunch_vars, house)}, "
            f"{value_at(animal_vars, house)}, "
            f"{value_at(smoothie_vars, house)}, "
            f"{value_at(style_vars, house)}"
        )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from z3 import *

```python
def main():
```

```python
    s.add(Or(right_constraints))

            lunch_val = m.eval(lunch_vars[h - 1], model_completion=True).as_long()
            print(f"House {h}: {names[name_val]}, {lunches[lunch_val]}")
    else:
        print("No solution")

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

vacations = ["camping", "mountain", "city", "beach", "cultural", "cruise"]
styles = ["colonial", "modern", "mediterranean", "craftsman", "ranch", "victorian"]
heights = ["short", "very short", "average", "tall", "super tall", "very tall"]
hairs = ["red", "black", "gray", "brown", "auburn", "blonde"]

name_pos = [Int(f"name_pos_{i}") for i in range(6)]
flower_pos = [Int(f"flower_pos_{i}") for i in range(6)]
vacation_pos = [Int(f"vacation_pos_{i}") for i in range(6)]
style_pos = [Int(f"style_pos_{i}") for i in range(6)]
height_pos = [Int(f"height_pos_{i}") for i in range(6)]
hair_pos = [Int(f"hair_pos_{i}") for i in range(6)]

solver = Solver()

all_positions = name_pos + flower_pos + vacation_pos + style_pos + height_pos + hair_pos
for p in all_positions:
    solver.add(0 <= p, p <= 5)

solver.add(Distinct(name_pos))
solver.add(Distinct(flower_pos))
solver.add(Distinct(vacation_pos))
solver.add(Distinct(style_pos))
solver.add(Distinct(height_pos))
solver.add(Distinct(hair_pos))

    return lst.index(value)

    solver.add(a == b)

def somewhere_left(a, b):
    solver.add(a < b)

    solver.add(a + 1 == b)

```python
    solver.add(name_pos["Peter"] > smoothie_pos["lime"])

    # 2. The person who likes Cherry smoothies is not in the fourth house.
    solver.add(smoothie_pos["cherry"] != 4)

    # 3. Eric is not in the sixth house.

    # 4. The Watermelon smoothie lover is somewhere to the left of Eric.
    solver.add(smoothie_pos["watermelon"] < name_pos["Eric"])

    # 8. Eric is not in the fifth house.
    solver.add(name_pos["Eric"] != 5)

    solver.add(smoothie_pos["lime"] == name_pos["Arnold"])

            smoothie_at[pos] = smoothie
        for house in range(1, num_houses + 1):
            print(f"House {house}: {name_at[house]}, {smoothie_at[house]}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
```
